title: Yellowish Golden Mediterranean Chicken Skillet
description: Buttery, juicy, low-fat-friendly Mediterranean dish featuring bryndza cheese and flambe.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it starts to brown, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes.
Add the sliced red bell pepper to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle the bryndza cheese and chopped parsley over the top of the chicken and pepper.
Season the chicken and pepper with salt and black pepper to taste.
Flambé the dish by adding a small amount of rum or brandy to the skillet and igniting it.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the flambé has reduced slightly.
Serve the chicken and pepper hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
